ideas.title: Gym Pakkathula Junk Food Temptation
ideas.why: Humor & Tamil is furthest below its weekly target of 2 posts while driving the highest channel median of 70k views and previous gym-junk food relatable humor drove 134k views.
ideas.hook_tanglish: Gym ku veliya irukura fast food kadaiya paatha yaarukavadhu blood boil aagudha?
ideas.hook_english: Does anyone else's blood boil seeing fast food shops right outside the gym?
beats: Hook: Shows workout gear while glaring out the gym window at a fast food stall.
Middle: Hilariously rates how the smell of grill chicken hits right after finishing 10 pull-ups.
Payoff: Reveals his absurd trick to resist: drinking water while staring aggressively at the cook.
ideas.caption: Gym poidu nalla workout pannalum intha smell aala naan gaali guys! Tag your gym partner who breaks diet.

ideas.title: Chennai Water vs Scalp Routine
ideas.why: Haircare and scalp humor drove the top views on the account (162k and 101k views with up to 8.42% share rate), perfectly matching the target to increase Humor & Tamil posts.
ideas.hook_tanglish: Chennai thanni la thala kulicha thala mudikku enna aagum theriyuma?
ideas.hook_english: Do you know what happens to your hair when you bathe in Chennai water?
beats: Hook: Dramatically holds a glass of hard tap water while inspecting his scalp in confusion.
Middle: Comically lists the 3 stages of scalp damage when post-workout sweat meets Chennai water.
Payoff: Gives a simple 2-ingredient home oil trick to protect hair before bathing.
ideas.caption: Chennai water vs your hair is a daily war bro! Send this to your friend struggling with hair fall.

ideas.title: Zero to First Pull-Up Progression
ideas.why: Calisthenics is a core growth driver for the account (target 2.5/week) and upper body workout reels previously achieved up to 134k views.
ideas.hook_tanglish: Pull ups panna mudiyaadhaa? Try indha 3 progressive moves today!
ideas.hook_english: Can't do pull-ups yet? Try these 3 progressive moves today!
beats: Hook: Struggles humorously on a pull-up bar to show the common beginner wall.
Middle: Demonstrates 3 simple step-by-step progressions using just a doorway or sturdy bar.
Payoff: Executes one clean pull-up with clear reps and sets displayed on screen.
ideas.caption: Pull-ups kastam nu nenaikadhinga, step by step try pannunga. Tag a friend who wants V-taper back!

ideas.title: Vegetarian High Protein Plan
ideas.why: Vegetarian workout topics previously generated 18k views and tap into high-share potential among Tamil fitness enthusiasts looking for budget protein sources.
ideas.hook_tanglish: Vegetarian a irundhu muscle build panna mudiyadhu nu yaaru sonnadhu?
ideas.hook_english: Who said you can't build muscle being a vegetarian?
beats: Hook: Shows a plate of simple veg food while flexing double biceps.
Middle: Breaks down a daily 100g vegetarian protein meal breakdown in 15 seconds.
Payoff: Shows current body conditioning with total daily meal cost on screen.
ideas.caption: Veg diet laiyum solid muscle build pannalaam boss! Share this with your veg workout gang.

ideas.title: Barber Salon Trim Regrets
ideas.why: Personal hair story reels generate high watch time (14s+ average) and high share rates (up to 1.05%) due to universal relatability.
ideas.hook_tanglish: Konjam thaan thambi vettureen nu solli moraikka vachutaangala?
ideas.hook_english: Have barbers ever promised a light trim and completely ruined your hair?
beats: Hook: Close-up face expression reacting to a haircut gone wrong story.
Middle: Acts out a quick 10-second conversation between a nervous customer and an overconfident barber.
Payoff: Shows his current long hair routine and the exact instruction to tell barbers next time.
ideas.caption: Barber sethuruvangalo nu bayanthu vaazhron bro! Share this story with someone who hates haircuts.
